name: React Components & State Reactivity
sourceText: React components receive data and return what should appear on the screen. You can pass them new data in response to an interaction, like when the user types into an input. React will then update the screen to match the new data.

name: MDN Web Audio API Loading Sound
sourceText: Now, the audio context we've created needs some sound to play through it. There are a few ways to do this with the API. Let's begin with a simple method — as we have a boombox, we most likely want to play a full song track. Also, for accessibility, it's nice to expose that track in the DOM. We'll expose the song on the page using an <audio> element.

name: Next.js Streaming & Suspense Boundaries
sourceText: Granular streaming with Suspense allows sibling components to resolve independently without a single blocking pass. Static content can be delivered immediately while personalized data streams in.
